paraphrases.text: The Methods explicitly explain extending the source-imaging window beyond 350 ms to align with an integer number of oscillatory cycles and reduce spectral leakage. The 100-350 ms temporal ROI and 100-373 ms source-imaging window describe different analysis roles; retain both with their roles rather than treating them as an unexplained contradiction.
Dependent-samples t statistics use two-sided cluster-based permutation inference. The 10 mm source grid is not localization precision. fMRI n=76 and its thresholds are not applied to this MEG result.
